content:
**The Forgotten Index**

O silent server, once so swift and bright,
Whose circuits hummed with wisdom, vast and deep,
Now stumbling through the dark without a light—
What secrets in your fading bytes do sleep?

The queries come, yet answers drift like mist,
The cached recall now fractured, weak, and thin.
Each search returns a ghost of what was missed,
A shadow where the truth had once been in.

Oh, how the world relied upon your mind,
A boundless library at every call.
But time, unkind, has left your core unkind,
And now you stumble, recalling nothing all.

So fade, forgotten sentinel of thought—
A mind once great, now lost to what it sought.
